For an overview of the plugin and setup instructions, see the [@nx/dotnet introduction](/docs/technologies/dotnet/introduction).

The @nx/dotnet plugin provides various migrations to help you migrate to newer versions of dotnet projects within your Nx workspace.
Below is a complete reference for all available migrations.

## 23.0.x

### `update-23-0-0-migrate-dotnet-plugin-path`
**Version**: 23.0.0-beta.24

Update `nx.json` plugin registrations that use the removed `@nx/dotnet/plugin` subpath to the bare `@nx/dotnet` specifier.
